newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Marks & Spencer to open Seoul outlets.
newsitem.headline: Marks & Spencer to open Seoul outlets.

text.p: International retailer Marks & Spencer said on Wednesday it will open its first two stores in South Korea next year with its new Korean partner.
The outlets would be opened in the capital, Seoul, in partnership with major South Korean conglomerate and retail operator, D&S Ltd, said Paul Smith, Marks & Spencer chief executive Asia Pacific.
Opening dates were yet to be announced, Smith said.

Marks & Spencer has 34 stores in six countries in the Asia Pacific region. These include eight wholly-owned stores in Hong Kong, six franchise shops in Singapore, six in the Philippines, six in Indonesia, six in Thailand, and two in Malaysia.
